patch_description: Add a second Ising interaction (XX) ring immediately after the existing ZZ ring, but reuse the SAME shared parameter name "zz_ring" rather than introducing a new parameter. This enriches the entangling subspace with an orthogonal interaction (XX complements ZZ, giving access to a richer set of two-qubit correlations useful for separating hard-to-classify groups) while keeping the trainable parameter count identical (still 5 distinct params), so we get potential margin/generalization gains without any parameter-economy penalty.
